sources.excerpt: --> Mid-Fi Electronics ::: Rise/OverRun HOME PEDALS PURCHASE Rise/OverRun First your signal is fuzzed up, then split into parallel low pass, and band pass filters. The frequency of the band pass filter is then modulated by a staircase shaped waveform, whose speed is controlled by the predominant frequency of whatever you’re feeding into the pedal.  Lower notes are slower, higher notes are faster. Controls for: Bandwidth: Flavor/intensity of filtering Division: Over all speed range of modulation  Volume: Output level Pedal has soft switch/relay based true bypass all content © 2026 Doug Tuttle Effects

Qty Add to Cart Description Mid-Fi Electronics Rise/OverRun Pedal The Mid-Fi Electronics Rise/OverRun Pedal brings a wild and expressive character to your sound. It takes your signal, shapes it in strange and musical ways, and gives you tones that shift, pulse, and move with your playing. It feels alive under your fingers and pushes you to try new ideas every time you step on it. Mid-Fi Electronics Rise/OverRun Pedal Review This pedal starts by adding a gritty fuzz to your tone, then sends your signal through two different filters at the same time. One stays smooth and low, while the other shifts up and down in a staircase pattern that reacts to the notes you play. Lower notes move slowly and higher notes move faster. You can fine tune the flavor, speed, and output so the effect fits perfectly into your setup. Mid-Fi Electronics Rise/OverRun Pedal Features Adds a bold fuzzy layer to your sound Creates moving filter effects that follow how you play Lets you control the feel of the sweep Lets you adjust the overall speed range Easy to set your final volume Uses a soft switching design for quiet on and off control Mid-Fi Electronics Rise/OverRun Pedal Specs Relay based true bypass switching Powered by standard 9V DC Parallel low pass and band pass filtering Band pass filter driven by a staircase style modulation wave More From Mid-Fi Electronics *Mid-Fi Electronics pedals come in a random color. The pedal makers choose at random when creating them. Please note that the pedal you receive may be a different color than what is pictured in this listing. We cannot provide returns due to the pedal’s color. You can however, request a certain color while ordering, and we’ll pass the request to the manufacturer before proceeding.
